body: Attempt Five doctrine adopted: observation-only, no activations. NOOR-1 in Pontiac. Tyler deliberate 11-sec hum for NOOR-1. Camera Op books rideshare to Pontiac 11:47 PM. 28.7 Hz shift as she crosses city limit. 23 miles away.
title: Build 0125: S00E01 'Neptune' — Jiangshi doctrine crisis, Neptune Aries, Camera Op arrives Detroit
